name: Kemp and Company Limited
about: Kemp and Company Limited engages in the retail of luggage products and accessories in India. It operates in Trading and Real Estate segments. The Trading segment engages in retailing plastic molded suitcases, brief and vanity cases, and other travel goods. This segment also invests and trades in hard and soft luggage. The Real Estate segment is involved in letting out commercial properties. The company was incorporated in 1882 and is based in Mumbai, India. Kemp and Company Limited is a subsidiary of Piramal Vibhuti Investments Limited.
